items.title: Healings
items.summary: Learn the healing method you will actually use — not a script to recite.
items.body: Lama Fera, Shalvik Mantra Rahasya, Saropa, Reiki, or Hunkara with Haleemi. She teaches the one that matches the work you want to hold. The course can start in Dehradun or at a distance.

faq.title: About the courses
faq.intro: The questions people ask before they start one.

items.q: Is a course the same as a sitting?
items.a: No. A sitting is work she holds for you. A course is so you can hold the method yourself. Some people do a sitting first. Some start with the course.

items.q: Do I need a sitting before I learn?
items.a: Not always. If you already know the method you want, write that. If you are not sure, tell her what you want to do with it. She will say if a sitting should come first.

items.q: Can I take a course if I am not in Dehradun?
items.a: Most of them, yes. Say you need it at a distance when you write. She will tell you if that course can be held that way.
It depends on the method. Some are a few sittings. Some take longer. She will say the shape after she hears what you want to hold.

items.q: How do I start a course?
items.a: WhatsApp +91 7668648224, email priyasinha1809@gmail.com, or use the contact page. Name the course if you know it. If not, say what you want to learn.
